description:
Years between BC (BCE) and AD (CE) years, with no year zero.

    Use for: 'bc to ad calculator', 'how many years ago was 44 bc', 'years between bc and ad',
    'is there a year zero', 'bce to ce converter', 'how long ago was 500 bc'.

    1 BC is followed by AD 1, so 1 BC to AD 1 is 1 year and 500 BC to AD 500 is 999. 44 BC
    to AD 2026 is 2,069 years (44 + 2026 - 1). Astronomical year 0 is 1 BC.

    Args:
        start_year: The first year, 1 or more.
        start_era: BC, BCE, AD or CE.
        end_year: The second year; omit for this year in New Zealand.
        end_era: BC, BCE, AD or CE.
        as_at: Optional date whose year is now.

    Returns:
        Years elapsed, direction, astronomical and ISO 8601 years, and years ago.
name: bc_to_ad_calculator
